data_streams.business_summary: Work order XML from Maximo, status-translated (e.g. VOORBEREID -> In Process), written to 4PS serviceOrders; the shared entry gateway maximoRestService validates and routes incoming Maximo webhook data to the JMS queue ettm.maximoFourpsWorkOrder before either consumer picks it up. Two parallel production implementations exist: VRI-group VRI variant (part1) and the non-VRI maximoFourps-group variant (part2), both consuming the same queue -- likely distinct context-group/environment deployments rather than a true duplicate; treat with medium confidence on which is authoritative for a given company context. (mechanism: REST webhook relay + JMS (ettm.maximoFourpsWorkOrder) + REST (4PS serviceOrders))
